title: A test: silver ore gathered at Errai Belt into storage at Ramen's Rest, Last Light (two jumps)

Errai Belt read 741 silver, 44,461 iron and 100,000 copper (table fields, 2.5 h before 03:20 UTC); min_left 600 closes the route once about 140 silver are taken, three times the need.
